typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	totblcalypsotradeservswapleg_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		LEGAL_ENTITY_ID as decimal(38,0),
		ATTRIBUTE_TYPE as string,
		ATTRIBUTE_VALUE as string,
		SHORT_NAME as string,
		LONG_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromcalypsodbaswapleg
fromcalypsodbaswapleg derive({Copy of ATTRIBUTE_VALUE} = ATTRIBUTE_VALUE,
		{Copy of ATTRIBUTE_TYPE} = ATTRIBUTE_TYPE,
		{Copy of LONG_NAME} = LONG_NAME,
		{Copy of LEGAL_ENTITY_ID} = toString(LEGAL_ENTITY_ID),
		{Copy of SHORT_NAME} = SHORT_NAME) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		legal_entity_id as string,
		attribute_type as string,
		short_name as string,
		attribute_value as string,
		long_name as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		legal_entity_id = {Copy of LEGAL_ENTITY_ID},
		attribute_type = {Copy of ATTRIBUTE_TYPE},
		short_name = {Copy of SHORT_NAME},
		attribute_value = {Copy of ATTRIBUTE_VALUE},
		long_name = {Copy of LONG_NAME}),
	partitionFileNames:[($totblcalypsotradeservswapleg_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> totblcalypsotradeservswapleg
